channel.title: Chris and Michaela: Under the Christmas Sky
channel.desc: Chris Packham and Michaela Strachan go on a Christmas adventure to explore some of nature's greatest celestial wonders and winter wildlife. Their quest takes them to the stunning Arabian desert in Jordan in search of the `star of Bethlehem', a rare conjunction of two planets that appear very bright and close together in the night sky.
